evidence: After ODTS deactivation, 8 ALD of a HfO 2 thin ﬁlm is carried out in a custom built reactor using high-purity tetrakis(dimethylamido)hafnium(IV) and deionized water. The HfO2 ALD process includes two self-limiting chemical reactions, repeated in alternating ABAB sequences shown below: A:Hf-OH* +H ffNsCH3d2g4 ! Hf-O-HffNsCH3d2g3 + NHsCH3d2", B:Hf-NsCH3d2* +H 2O ! Hf-OH* +N HsCH3d2", where the asterisks represent the surface species. The exposure times for Hf fNsCH3d2g4 and water vapor were 0.1 and 0.2 s, respectively, followed by a 3 min nitrogen purge after each precursor was introduced into the chamber.
